items.headline: an AI that only reads a web page cannot be tricked by it.
items.hook: Myth: an AI that only reads a web page cannot be tricked by it.
points: Reality: text on a page can contain instructions aimed at the model. This is called prompt injection, and it is listed among the main security risks for AI applications.
Anything an AI reads from outside is untrusted input.
items.ask: Which AI myth did you believe the longest?
